source_event: v101 identified exactly one clean local moving-pass receive-to-second-foot event in the consumed v95 combined/s02 trajectory; s06 is excluded from receiver training because the ball is near stationary before first receiver touch.
hypothesis: A bounded two-parameter receive teacher (aim yaw and ankle lateral offset) around that physical B6 event may extend a clean local second-foot basin to s04 without destabilizing six G1 bodies.
local_b6_gate: Both scenes require six-body safe, clean physical source/receiver transfer, receiver first-touch incoming speed >=0.30 m/s, and own second foot contact >=0.20 s later with outgoing speed >=2.0 m/s and no intervening nonfoot ball contact or robot collision. If no candidate passes, reject all and do not open Fresh. A passed consumed teacher is still not a learned actor or promotional result.
selection: Among candidates passing all hard gates, choose the highest minimum outgoing second-foot speed across both scenes; tie-break by smallest absolute yaw then closest offset to 0.18 m. No selection from failed candidates.
fresh_boundary: If training passes, freeze one candidate and only then author a separate disjoint Fresh protocol before running any new scene. Do not reuse s02/s04 as Fresh.
